content: We have combined subnetworks with resistor IDs R1-R3 from subnet1, and R4-R7 from subnet2. The simulated resistances match measurements: A-B 66.363 vs 66.364 (close), A-N_b1 21.363 vs 21.364, A-N_b2 31.363 vs 31.364, etc. Need also other measurements like A-N_b3, A-X1, B-X1, etc. Let's test a few more to ensure full match.
